title: RoslynSense configuration
description: Settings for RoslynSense. Merged from every layer that applies: the global file in ~/.roslynsense, every roslynsense.json from the filesystem root down to the working directory, each one's roslynsense.local.json sibling, and the personal file ~/.roslynsense keeps for this directory. Nearest wins, field by field.

webForms.title: WebForms
webForms.description: ASPX, ASCX and master pages: controls, properties and event handlers as C# symbols.

proto.title: Protobuf
proto.description: `.proto` files joined to the C# they generate.

mediator.title: Mediator
mediator.description: Request and handler types joined across a mediator dispatch.

resources.title: Resources
resources.description: `.resx` files: which file a resource key lives in, from C# and from markup.

appSettings.title: appsettings.json
appSettings.description: `appsettings*.json` keys joined to the configuration reads that name them.

webConfig.title: web.config
webConfig.description: `<appSettings>` and `<connectionStrings>` joined to the C# and markup that read them.

dotSettings.title: ReSharper settings
dotSettings.description: Whether a committed `.DotSettings` narrows inferred namespaces, search results and coverage.

logging.title: Logging templates
logging.description: The `{Placeholder}` of a logging message joined to the value it prints. Microsoft.Extensions.Logging, Serilog and NLog.

profiling.title: Profiling
profiling.description: CPU sampling, memory snapshots and coverage.

database.title: Database
database.description: Querying and describing the databases the solution connects to.

tools.title: Language packs
tools.description: Which parts of RoslynSense are switched on. Turning one off removes its MCP tools and stops it answering editor requests.

autoDiscovery.title: Auto-discovery
autoDiscovery.description: Scan the tree for connection strings. Omitted runs the scan only when nothing is registered explicitly. Production-flavoured environment names are never loaded.

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: Explicit connections by alias. Either `provider:connectionString` or an object with `provider` and `connectionString`.

database.title: Databases
database.description: Which databases the solution can be queried against.

preset.title: Preset
preset.description: A built-in lookup set to start from: `webforms`, `dnn`, `dotnet`, or `none`. Omitted merges all three, which is the recommended setting.

include.title: Include
include.description: Globs relative to the project directory. Empty means every `.resx` outside `bin` and `obj`.

exclude.title: Exclude
exclude.description: Globs removed from what Include found, applied first.

pattern.title: Segment
pattern.description: The segment as it appears in the file name, `*` allowed — DNN's `Host` and `Portal-*`.

rank.title: Wins over
rank.description: Higher wins. The uncustomized file is 0, so `Host` is 1 and `Portal-*` is 2. Explicit because sorting `Portal-*` and `Host` alphabetically gets the precedence backwards.

items.title: Override
items.description: One customization segment and how strongly it wins.

overrides.title: Overrides
overrides.description: Customization segments beside a base file, such as DNN's `Portal-*`. Replaces the preset's set rather than adding to it.

id.title: Name
id.description: What a lookup's Fallbacks refers to this by. Reusing the name of a built-in convention replaces it and leaves the rest alone.

siblingFolder.title: Folder beside the file
siblingFolder.description: Looked for next to the calling file — `App_LocalResources`. Use this or Folder at the project root, not both.

rootFolder.title: Folder at the project root
rootFolder.description: Looked for from the project root down — `App_GlobalResources`.

fixedName.title: Always this file
fixedName.description: One file name every call site shares, such as `SharedResources`. Leave empty to name the file after the calling file.

suffix.title: File endings
suffix.description: What the resx name ends with. `.ascx.resx` for a user control's local file; defaults to `.resx`.

items.title: Convention
items.description: One way of getting from a call site to the resx file it reads.

conventions.title: Conventions
conventions.description: Named ways of turning a call-site file into a resx base name. Merged into the preset's by id.

containingType.title: Class
containingType.description: The full name of the class or interface declaring the method — `DotNetNuke.Services.Localization.Localization`. Leave empty to match the method on any class, which is the escape hatch for a codebase where each module wraps localization in its own helper.

methodName.title: Method
methodName.description: The method name, or `Item` for an indexer.

parameterTypes.title: Parameters
parameterTypes.description: One type name per parameter, `*` for a parameter of any type. Leave empty to match every overload — which is wrong wherever overloads disagree about where the file name sits.

keyIndex.title: Key is parameter
keyIndex.description: Which parameter carries the resource key, counted from 0.

rootSource.title: File name comes from
rootSource.description: Where the call site says which resx file to read.

rootInterpretation.title: Read that as
rootInterpretation.description: What kind of name that value is, which decides how it becomes a resx file.

rootIndex.title: File name is parameter
rootIndex.description: Which parameter carries it, counted from 0. Only used when the file name comes from an argument.

rootConstant.title: Fixed name
rootConstant.description: The file name itself, for a helper that always reads one file. Only used when the file name is fixed.

defaultKeySuffix.title: Add to keys without a dot
defaultKeySuffix.description: Appended to a key that contains no `.` — DNN's `.Text`, so `GetString("Submit")` reads `Submit.Text`.

fallbacks.title: Then also look in
fallbacks.description: Tried in order when the key is not in the first file. The list is what the preset defines plus any convention this file adds.

items.title: Lookup
items.description: One method that takes a resource key, and where the file it reads comes from.

lookups.title: Lookups
lookups.description: Call shapes that carry a resource key. Appended to the preset's.

markupBindings.title: Markup bindings
markupBindings.description: Key shapes an application composes from a markup attribute rather than any call site writing them out, each written as the key it produces: `[Control.ID].Text`, `Header[Control.UniqueName].Text`, `[Control.ID].Header`. Appended to the preset's.

missingKeyDiagnostic.title: Report missing keys
missingKeyDiagnostic.description: Report a key that no file of its family declares. Off by default: a false report on a key that resolves fine at runtime is what gets the feature switched off wholesale.

resources.title: Resource lookups
resources.description: How `.resx` files are found and which call shapes carry a resource key.

additionalFiles.title: Additional files
additionalFiles.description: File names claimed alongside `web.config` and `app.config` — for frameworks that keep their own, such as DotNetNuke's `release.config` and `development.config`. Names only, not paths or globs.

webConfig.title: web.config files
webConfig.description: Which files the web.config pack treats as Framework configuration.

templateSyntax.title: Malformed template
templateSyntax.description: LOG0001 — an unclosed brace or a placeholder naming nothing. Microsoft.Extensions.Logging throws on the first of those rather than rendering it oddly.

unknownPlaceholder.title: Placeholder names no parameter
unknownPlaceholder.description: LOG0002 — a placeholder in a `[LoggerMessage]` message that matches no parameter, so it prints as literal text. SYSLIB1014's claim, reported on the placeholder.

valueCount.title: Wrong number of values
valueCount.description: LOG0003 — the placeholders and the values disagree in count. Placeholders bind by position, so this shifts every placeholder after the mistake onto the wrong value.

unusedValue.title: Value never printed
unusedValue.description: LOG0004 — a parameter or argument no placeholder renders. SYSLIB1015's claim for a generated method, reported on the parameter.

exceptionPosition.title: Exception in the wrong place
exceptionPosition.description: LOG0005 — an exception passed as a rendered value rather than as the first argument, which loses the stack trace and the sink's exception handling.

logging.title: Logging templates
logging.description: Which of the message-template rules report. Two of them restate what the `[LoggerMessage]` source generator says as SYSLIB1014 and SYSLIB1015, at a better location — turn those off where the generator runs.

justMyCode.title: Just My Code
justMyCode.description: Step past `DebuggerStepThrough`, `DebuggerHidden`, `DebuggerNonUserCode`, and code with no symbols.

rawView.title: Raw View
rawView.description: Offer a Raw View child whenever a proxy or a hidden member means the listed children are not the object's own fields.

maxChildren.title: Max children
maxChildren.description: How many children of one value to list before truncating. Defaults to 100.

debugger.title: Debugger view
debugger.description: Which `System.Diagnostics` attributes the debug engines honour while inspecting and stepping.

tableFormat.title: Table format
tableFormat.description: How tabular tool output is rendered: `markdown` (default) or `toon`.

preload.title: Preload
preload.description: Solutions or projects to load on startup. Omitted auto-discovers the first solution in the working directory; an empty list disables preloading.

sharedHost.title: Shared host
sharedHost.description: Load each solution once per machine and share it across every editor window and chat, instead of once per client.

hostIdleMinutes.title: Host idle timeout
hostIdleMinutes.description: Minutes the shared host stays alive after its last client disconnects.

maxWorkspaces.title: Cached workspaces
maxWorkspaces.description: How many loaded solutions one process keeps before evicting the least recently used.
